A field guide to an inhabited world · volume V · the serpent family

Lamia

Five serpent monster girls: a woman's upper body on a long, muscular snake's tail. Python, king cobra, sea snake, rattlesnake and boa. They are cold-blooded, so warmth decides how they live: they bask in the sun, slow down in the cold, and bond with whoever shares a fire with them.

I · HarpiesII · Bullywugs & Mucus ToadsIII · NekomataIV · KitsuneV · LamiaVI · ArachneVII · CentaursVIII · MerfolkIX · Slimes
The central similarity

Cold blood, warm heart.

A lamia's body runs on outside warmth. In the sun or by a fire she is quick, curious and sharp; in the cold she grows slow and drowsy. Warmth is to this family what water is to the anurans, and sharing it is how you win one over.

  • WarmthA hidden value: sunlight, campfires, lava and magma raise it; night, rain and snow lower it.
  • CoilsShe holds enemies in her coils, and holds the people she loves (a protective hug).
  • SheddingEvery few days she sheds her skin and leaves (or gives) a Shed Skin.
  • Eggs or live youngPython and cobra lay eggs and guard them; sea snake, rattlesnake and boa give birth to live young.

Relationships (shared by every family)

The same relationship core runs through all MonsterGirls families, from the harpies on. This volume only changes how a lamia builds trust, what she gives back, and how she bears young.

AffectionEach monster girl remembers every player separately. Feeding, petting and her family's own bond action raise it; hurting her lowers it. /monstergirls bonds lists everyone nearby.
SitRight-click any monster girl with a plain stick to make her sit; again to let her get up.
Sharing a bedAt high friendship (25) she may join you in bed: once a night she decides, one in three at 25, certain at 100. Sleep through the night and she is expecting.
ExpectingA pregnancy lasts one in-game day. Her belly rounds out as it goes on (the model shows it).
Born devotedHer young are born devoted to the player who fathered them (full affection) and never share that player's bed.
PresentsAt high friendship every family brings presents of its own kind.
BondAffectionWhat it means
Wild0Keeps her distance; her species' instincts decide everything.
Curious3+Lets you come close and watches what you do.
Fond10+Follows you a little way, accepts petting, stops fleeing.
High friendship25+May join you in bed at night (one night in three, more the fonder she is) and brings presents.
Devoted60+The family's devoted perk unlocks (see each guide).
Full devotion100The most there is. Every daughter feels this for the player who fathered her.

Friendship

What builds trust

  • Warmth shared: stand by a campfire with her at night (+1 per minute, up to fond)
  • Eggs, rabbit, chicken, fish
  • Petting the right way (the stick-free hand, never while she is shedding)
  • A warm, sunny basking spot near your home

What costs trust

  • Waking her from brumation
  • Splashing her with cold water or snowballs
  • Touching her eggs
  • Hitting her

Devoted (60+)

She coils around you to protect you: when you take damage while she is next to you, she takes half of it on her coils (she has plenty of armour).

Mating & young

FormEggs (python, cobra) or live young (sea snake, rattlesnake, boa). YoungSnakelets (2-5), grown in 5 days. WhereWarm sand, dirt or a leaf nest; live young wherever she basks. Lamia eggs reuse the egg block idea from the harpies with their own leathery texture.

1. CourtshipAt high friendship, sleeping in a warm room (a lit fireplace, a campfire or a furnace within 6 blocks) helps: she is twice as likely to join you, coiling around the bed's foot. By morning she is expecting.
2a. Egg-layersThe python lays a clutch of three to five leathery eggs in warm sand or dirt and coils around them, shivering to keep them warm (brooding). The king cobra is the only snake that builds a nest: she heaps leaves over her eggs and guards them fiercely.
2b. Live-bearersThe sea snake, the rattlesnake and the boa give birth to two to four snakelets wherever they are basking.
3. GrownSnakelets (small, chibi-headed) bask beside their mother and grow up in five days. Devoted to their father from the first day.

Behaviour & gameplay (shared by the family)

WarmthWarm: normal speed, alert. Cool (night, rain): slower and sleepy. Cold (snow biomes, deep caves): she curls up and brumates until it warms up, and is grumpy if woken. She seeks sun on stone and sand, and campfires.
CoilsIn a fight she grabs a mob in her coils: it cannot move and takes squeezing damage until it breaks free. Asleep beside a bonded player she coils around them: they wake with Resistance I, and never freeze while she is there.
Tongue senseShe flicks her tongue and tastes the air: she knows where invisible and hidden mobs are. A bonded lamia makes invisible mobs within 16 blocks glow for her player.
Hypnotic gazeShe sways and fixes a mob with her eyes until it stops moving (Slowness V for three seconds). She uses it on anything that threatens her player.
Swallow wholeShe swallows eggs (chicken and turtle eggs), rabbits and chickens whole, and then lies digesting for a day with a rounded middle. The belly bone does double duty.
SheddingEvery three to five days her colours go dull and she sheds, leaving a Shed Skin (an item: a light leather that crafts into leather, and a charm ingredient). A bonded lamia gives it to you.

Species profiles

Jungle & swampGentle · heavy

Python (about 2.0 blocks)

TemperamentSlow, gentle, very affectionate when warm

Ecology & behaviourThe heaviest lamia: a long, thick tail and a calm temper. Basks for hours, lies in water in the heat, and constricts rather than bites.

Signature: Coiled brood & warm hugShe broods her eggs by shivering (they hatch twice as fast). Bonded, she is the best bed partner in the mod: Resistance I and Regeneration I on waking.

Player interactionShare a campfire with her. Never startle her when she is cold.

King Cobra (about 2.2 blocks)

TemperamentProud, alert, dramatic

Ecology & behaviourRears up a third of her length and spreads her hood when threatened, with a low growl of a hiss. Hunts other snakes. Builds a real nest of leaves for her eggs and guards it.

Signature: Hood & snake charmingThe hood display is a warning: back off and nothing happens; come closer and she spits venom (Blindness and Poison). A jukebox within 16 blocks keeps her calm, and a bonded cobra sways to it (the existing music system).

Player interactionMusic calms her: play a record near her and she sways along instead of rearing.

DangerHigh if threatened; she always warns first.

Warm ocean & beachesAquatic · docile

Sea Snake (about 1.9 blocks)

TemperamentDocile, inquisitive, unbothered

Ecology & behaviourA flattened paddle tail and nostrils that close: she lives in the reef and comes ashore only to bask on rocks. Her venom is the strongest of any lamia, and she almost never uses it.

Signature: Reef guide & breath sharingIn a boat or swimming, a bonded sea snake leads you towards the nearest shipwreck or ocean ruin. Swimming beside her you have Water Breathing.

Player interactionSwim with her. She follows divers out of curiosity.

Desert & badlandsFair · warning

Rattlesnake (about 1.85 blocks)

TemperamentPrickly, fair, protective

Ecology & behaviourRests in the shade of rocks and dead bushes by day and hunts at night with heat-sensing pits that let her see warm bodies in the dark. Gives birth to live young and guards them.

Signature: Fair warning & heat sightThree stages like the ostrich: rattle, rattle louder and coil, then strike (Poison II). At night a bonded rattlesnake marks warm mobs within 20 blocks with Glowing for her player.

Player interactionListen for the rattle and step back. She only strikes when ignored.

Boa (about 1.95 blocks)

TemperamentLaid-back, friendly, a little lazy

Ecology & behaviourHangs from branches by her tail and drops onto prey. Gives birth to live young. The easiest lamia to befriend: she is curious about people and loves being carried around (she follows you closely).

Signature: Tree ambush & easy bondShe hangs from leaves and logs and drops onto mobs walking below. Affection gifts count double with her.

Player interactionOffer a rabbit and an arm to hold. She bonds fastest of the family (every gift counts double).

In the game

Built (2026-10-19)

  • Warmth: sun and heat warm her, cold slows her, brumation in the cold
  • Basking
  • Coils (Slowness IV on a hit)
  • Tongue sense, hypnotic gaze
  • Swallowing eggs whole (a round middle)
  • Shed Skin every 3-5 days
  • Campfire bond up to fond
  • Devoted damage share
  • Bed perk: Resistance (python: also Regeneration)
  • Python and cobra lay leathery clutches (cobra heaps leaves; a brooding python doubles hatching speed); the others bear 2-4 live young
  • Cobra hood, spit and calm under music; sea snake breath and reef guide; rattlesnake warnings and heat sight; boa double bonding and climbing

Not yet

  • The boa dropping onto prey from branches
  • A Shed Skin cloak

Design decisions log

Decided (2026-10-19)

  • Only the king cobra builds a nest, as in real life; it makes her the guard of the family.
  • Warmth replaces the anurans' moisture as the family's survival value, but it never kills: cold only slows and sleeps her.
  • The tail is a chain of segments (tail_1..tail_8) so it can curl, coil and slither.

Open questions

  • Should Shed Skin craft a light armour (a snakeskin cloak)?
  • Should a lamia carry the player in her coils as a slow mount?
